title: A will, twelve heirs
text: Lord Hollowmere is dead and the will is read at midnight. Secretly back a few of the twelve heirs.

title: Move ANY heir
text: On your turn, roll two dice and move any heirs around the mansion, not just yours.

title: Spring the traps
text: Play trap cards on whoever is standing in a trap. Get rid of rivals' heirs without giving away your own.

title: Who inherits
text: The heir named in the will wins by walking out the front door. Otherwise the will decides at midnight, or the last player with an heir standing wins.
